title: Sudan: Misery worsens amid plummeting aid for displaced people

blocks.text: The International Organization for Migration (IOM) and the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) are sounding the alarm: Serious funding gaps have depleted the supplies of emergency shelter and basic household goods intended for Sudan. Without urgent provision of flexible funding, even more families will have to cope without adequate protection from extreme weather conditions, insecurity, violence and exploitation in the coming months. “Our supplies are running out.” At the Palais des Nations today, Dr. Mohamed Refaat @_Moh_Refaat, IOM Chief of Mission in Sudan, warned that 15.4 million people urgently need shelter and essential supplies. With stocks running low, IOM […]... Keep on reading: Sudan: Misery worsens amid plummeting aid for displaced people
